summary: HDFC Bank Limited files a Form 6-K (equivalent to a U.S. material event report) disclosing RBI approval for its group entities to hold up to 9.95% of shares in ICICI Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank, valid for one year. The bank itself does not intend to invest; the filing addresses regulatory limits on aggregate holdings by promoter-group entities. This is routine regulatory disclosure about passive investment limits, not an acquisition or special situation. No deal terms, premium, or board recommendations are provided. The filing clarifies the investment is in the normal course of business for group entities.
